as_told.title: Bissell briefed Malmgren on otherworldly technologies

plain: This story is about Harald Malmgren, a man described as a presidential advisor, and Richard Bissell, a senior official at the CIA, the US spy agency. According to the story, Bissell told Malmgren in a private briefing about what he called "otherworld technologies" that the agency had been trying to recover and understand. Malmgren tells it himself on the podcast of a host named Jesse Michels, saying that these were forces beyond the CIA's knowledge or control, and that they may have interfered with the CIA's work with private industry. The tellers disagree on when it happened: the story's own date is about 1973, Malmgren puts it in 1963, and others say the 1950s and 60s or 1962. An analyst named Matthew Pines retells it twice from Malmgren, Michels repeats it and adds that the briefing covered past crash retrievals, including a supposed 1933 crash called Magenta, and an online researcher known as UAPGerb mentions it as alleged, crediting a man named Randy Anderson. If true, it would mean the CIA knew for decades that it held technology not made by humans.
